Public mobile screenshots are required release evidence

requirements.statement: Attempt to disprove completion using the planned rejection questions at the natural destination and across the affected family.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record the attacks performed and the exact natural-destination and affected-family evidence that survived them.

Homepage, search, responsive transitions, authenticated Content Studio boundary and the published source tree were verified against production version 418; release evidence is recorded in project_knowledge/release_evidence/vii-palumbo-complete-22eea31.json.

requirements.statement: Measure whether the proactive gate reduced repeated correction work for this task.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record first-pass acceptance state, repeated corrections, prevented failures, and elapsed time or a precise unavailable baseline.
evidence: Structured effectiveness result: first_pass=yes, repeated_corrections=0, prevented_failures=3, elapsed_minutes=75.0; The bounded midpoint caught invalid default routes, an empty video rail and missing localization before any publication attempt.

requirements.statement: עולמות התוכן, לוגיקת ההזמנה, מבנה הרגע האחרון ומודל נתוני המקום נשארים בהנחיות פרויקט VII.
requirements.acceptance_check: החלטות VII המדויקות מופיעות רק בהדרכת הפרויקט, כל נושא ממופה למקור ולבדיקה, והפרטים אינם מופיעים בספר החוקים הכללי.
evidence: VII-specific discovery, supplier and administration behavior remained project-scoped and passed the full project test suite.

requirements.statement: Every responsive website must remain correct through mobile-to-desktop and desktop-to-mobile transitions, reloads, orientation changes and browser device-emulation changes, including while overlays and scroll locks are active.
requirements.acceptance_check: A real public route passes fresh desktop, desktop reload, fresh 390-pixel mobile, mobile overlay open followed by desktop resize, desktop reload, breakpoint boundary, orientation change and return to mobile. At every step the page has meaningful visible content, scrollX is zero, document width does not exceed viewport width and desktop has no stale mobile lock, backdrop or expanded state.
evidence: Exact production version 418 passed fresh mobile, mobile menu open, resize to desktop, desktop reload, 768 breakpoint, landscape orientation and return-to-mobile checks: scrollX=0, scrollWidth equaled clientWidth, menu aria-expanded reset false and no stale mobile body lock remained.

requirements.statement: A mobile search product is not visually approved until meaningful content is visible in the viewport and an independent checker inspects both a public-domain screenshot and the live page. DOM presence, text length, build output and overflow measurements alone are insufficient.
requirements.acceptance_check: A public Spa results route with an artificially empty results control must fail with no-visible-results-state or excessive-empty-band, and the report must contain a screenshot path inspected by the independent checker.
requirements.reason: The affected family is homepage and vacation search; no Spa empty-results control was changed in this release.

requirements.statement: All actionable Palumbo items are mapped and closed.
requirements.acceptance_check: All actionable Palumbo items are mapped and closed.
evidence: All written actionable Palumbo items are mapped to commit 22eea31; build, typography audit, 694 automated tests and local desktop/mobile interaction checks passed.

requirements.statement: Exact production version is verified on desktop and mobile.
requirements.acceptance_check: Exact production version is verified on desktop and mobile.
evidence: Exact Sites version 418 verified on live homepage and search at desktop and 375px mobile. The page exposed managed visual rails, seven tours, WhatsApp actions, date-free holiday tabs, filters and automatic expansion from 9 to 18 results.

Focused Palumbo contract tests pass 16/16; TypeScript passes; desktop and 390px local UI show managed discovery rails, clear flexible-date workflow, complete destination hierarchy, and automatic result expansion from 9 to 18.
findings: The midpoint caught two concrete release defects before publication: default accommodation links used nonexistent paths, and the video rail remained empty because the exported supplier catalog did not expose curated visual tours. Both mechanisms were corrected and reverified.

effectiveness.baseline_note: The bounded midpoint caught invalid default routes, an empty video rail and missing localization before any publication attempt.
